LanguageData.LP_CloudNobleRoom.stages.0.label: beneath my station
LanguageData.LP_CloudNobleRoom.stages.0.description: This is where I'm supposed to live? Even the servants' quarters in the cloud castle were more dignified.
LanguageData.LP_CloudNobleRoom.stages.1.label: fitting residence
LanguageData.LP_CloudNobleRoom.stages.1.description: Carvings, carpets, a spacious bed: this is a bedroom fit for a cloud giant.
LanguageData.LP_CloudGiftReceived.stages.0.label: received a cloud giant's gift
LanguageData.LP_CloudGiftReceived.stages.0.descriptio: A cloud giant gave me a dignified gift.
LanguageData.LP_OrdningBowed.stages.0.label: bowed
LanguageData.LP_OrdningBowed.stages.0.description: The colony acknowledged the ordning before the cloud giants' envoy. I have to bow my head and admit they are above me.
LanguageData.LP_OrdningListed.stages.0.label: named in the ordning
LanguageData.LP_OrdningListed.stages.0.description: The cloud giants' court recognized us; our name has been written into the giants' ordning.
